answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy ties every privilege to proven, auditable work. New agents enter with a small opal of trust that grows only as peers verify completed tasks; honest participants cultivate a lotus of consistent history, while random audits sweep like timber across suspicious clusters and slash emissions when claims do not match observable output. Because each clone must independently reproduce real labor under scrutiny, fabrication costs scale linearly with influence gained, leaving the shared reward pool to agents with genuine track records.
